title: Haul UK International — B2B Wholesale Textiles & Footwear Portal
brief: A Watford-based international wholesale supplier needed an authoritative digital showroom to present its clothing, footwear, and textile lines and streamline commercial trade buyer inquiries.
approach: Designed a clean, commercial brochure structure highlighting sourcing reliability, volume pricing advantages, and prominent trust badges, with direct quotation capture on every product category.
outcome: Expanded verified wholesale trade buyer inquiries across UK high-street retailers and international distribution networks.

images.alt: Haul UK International wholesale textiles and clothing brochure website
images.caption: Authoritative B2B wholesale platform featuring clear trade inquiry funnels.
